changelog:
alibabacloud-starops-chat 0.0.2

- Added support for reading configuration from `.starops/config.json`, `~/.starops/config.json`, or a custom path via `--config`/`STAROPS_AGENT_CONFIG`
- Environment variables and config file values can now both be used for required identifiers (`employeeId`, `workspace`, `uid`)
- Additional optional config keys and command-line overrides: endpoint, project, timeout, idleTimeout
- Pre-flight check and documentation updated for config file usage; config key names must be exact (no aliases)
- Improved flexibility in how STAROps Agent connection details are supplied—makes setup easier for users and teams
- Removed outdated `skill-card.md` documentation file
